mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, workitem_id, conversation_id, turn_id, uploader_user_id, name, content_type, size_bytes, oss_ref, previewable, deleting_at, gmt_create
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clarification_attachment (tenant_id, workitem_id, conversation_id, turn_id, uploader_user_id, name, content_type, size_bytes, oss_ref, previewable) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workitemId}, #{conversationId}, #{turnId}, #{uploaderUserId}, #{name}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{ossRef}, #{previewable})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM clarification_attachment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM clarification_attachment WHERE (deleting_at IS NOT NULL) OR (turn_id IS NULL AND gmt_create < #{cutoff}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM clarification_attachment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND workitem_id = #{workitemId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM clarification_attachment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
